name: THAD'S ROOM
note: Room 19, doc 20, directly above the lobby. Warm-neutral against the hotel's cool, per errata 30d -- neutral beside cool reads as nothing, so the drab here is warm drab. Composed to the frozen standard; NO HOTSPOTS YET. The examine layer arrives with the document being written for this room -- a hotspot with no line is worse than no hotspot, and check-examine-lines says so. Every door here is marked stub for the same reason: the destination exists so the exit works and the lines are honestly absent rather than invented.
materialIdentity: Neutral drab: bare pine, unbleached calico, a tin basin. Warm-neutral so it separates by hue from the hotel's blue directly below it

paletteScript.note: ERRATA 23's proportions and 30f's step 0, committed from renders/interior-identity-plan. Dominant 55-70%, structural shadow 15-25%, secondary local colour 10-15%, narrative accent 3-8%.

entrances.note: In at the door, with the bed across the room and the window ahead.
